note: the agent's column inventory as agent_ro: a sample of one collection's documents, each field name and JSON type, sent as the agent path sends it

query.statement: SELECT DISTINCT "_default" AS table_schema, "_default" AS table_name, p.name AS column_name, TYPE(p.val) AS data_type FROM (SELECT RAW d FROM `_default`.`_default` AS d LIMIT 100) AS doc UNNEST OBJECT_PAIRS(doc) AS p ORDER BY p.name, TYPE(p.val)

SELECT DISTINCT "s1" AS table_schema, "c1" AS table_name, p.name AS column_name, TYPE(p.val) AS data_type FROM (SELECT RAW d FROM `s1`.`c1` AS d LIMIT 100) AS doc UNNEST OBJECT_PAIRS(doc) AS p ORDER BY p.name, TYPE(p.val)

SELECT DISTINCT "s1" AS table_schema, "nope" AS table_name, p.name AS column_name, TYPE(p.val) AS data_type FROM (SELECT RAW d FROM `s1`.`nope` AS d LIMIT 100) AS doc UNNEST OBJECT_PAIRS(doc) AS p ORDER BY p.name, TYPE(p.val)
SELECT k.`scope` AS table_schema, k.name AS table_name FROM system:keyspaces AS k WHERE k.`bucket` = "probe" ORDER BY k.`scope`, k.name
